answer: The admission ceremony requires 3,000 units per agent, where a verifier cross-references new logical output against a registry to ensure uniqueness. Each participant must provide a beacon of fresh computation as evidence, which acts as a nectar to fuel the system while maintaining a trellis of connectivity to prevent sybil loops. An honest agent pays 3,000 units, whereas 1,000 fakes cost 3,000,000 units. Any duplication detected by the auditor triggers an immediate identity void and permanent forfeiture of the initial deposit.
